property.name: hbase.resource.hierarchical.enabled
property.description: Enable hierarchical resource management for HBase. When enabled, provides fair scheduling, throttling, and resource allocation.

property.name: hbase.resource.hierarchical.scheduler.policy
property.description: Scheduling policy for resource allocation. Supported values: FAIR_SHARE, FIFO, DRF

property.name: hbase.resource.scheduler.fair.preemption.enabled
property.description: Enable preemption in fair share scheduler. When a pool exceeds its fair share for longer than the timeout, resources may be preempted from it.

property.name: hbase.resource.scheduler.fair.preemption.timeout.ms
property.description: Time in milliseconds after which resources may be preempted from a pool that has exceeded its fair share.

property.name: hbase.resource.scheduler.allocation.wait.max.ms
property.description: Maximum time in milliseconds a resource request will wait for allocation.

property.name: hbase.resource.hierarchical.metrics.update.interval.ms
property.description: Interval in milliseconds at which resource metrics are updated.

property.name: hbase.resource.hierarchical.throttle.enabled
property.description: Enable request throttling based on resource utilization and rate limits.

property.name: hbase.resource.throttle.global.rps.limit
property.description: Global requests per second limit for all users and applications.

property.name: hbase.resource.throttle.user.rps.limit
property.description: Per-user requests per second limit.

property.name: hbase.resource.throttle.namespace.rps.limit
property.description: Per-namespace requests per second limit.

property.name: hbase.resource.throttle.table.rps.limit
property.description: Per-table requests per second limit.

property.name: hbase.resource.throttle.memory.threshold
property.description: Memory utilization threshold (0.0 to 1.0) above which requests are throttled.

property.name: hbase.resource.throttle.cpu.threshold
property.description: CPU utilization threshold (0.0 to 1.0) above which requests are throttled.

property.name: hbase.resource.throttle.io.threshold
property.description: I/O utilization threshold (0.0 to 1.0) above which requests are throttled.

property.name: hbase.resource.config.storage.type
property.description: Storage type for resource configuration. Supported values: memory, zookeeper, file

property.name: hbase.resource.config.refresh.interval.ms
property.description: Interval in milliseconds at which configuration is refreshed from storage.

property.name: hbase.resource.metrics.enabled
property.description: Enable collection of resource management metrics.

property.name: hbase.resource.metrics.history.size
property.description: Number of historical metric values to retain for histogram calculations.

property.name: hbase.resource.manager.web.ui.enabled
property.description: Enable the web-based resource management dashboard.

property.name: hbase.resource.manager.http.address
property.description: Address for the resource manager web interface.

property.name: hbase.resource.manager.http.port
property.description: Port for the resource manager web interface.

property.name: hbase.resource.pool.root.memory.max.mb
property.description: Maximum memory allocation for the root resource pool in MB.

property.name: hbase.resource.pool.root.cpu.max.cores
property.description: Maximum CPU cores allocation for the root resource pool.

property.name: hbase.resource.pool.root.io.max.weight
property.description: Maximum I/O weight allocation for the root resource pool.
